states.name: Jammu & Kashmir
states.culture: Muslim-majority Kashmir valley shops heavily for Eid (pherans, suits, dry fruits, bakery); Hindu/Sikh-majority Jammu follows Punjabi-north Indian calendar (Lohri, Navratri, Diwali). Harsh winters drive heating/winter-wear buys.
states.ecommerce: Srinagar traders blame e-commerce (Myntra, Amazon, Meesho, Flipkart) for denting Eid sales; one trade body cited ~70% drop in a pre-Eid season. Instagram/WhatsApp sellers active for Eid suits, hampers, Iftar food.

festivals.name: Eid al-Fitr
festivals.significance: End of Ramadan; biggest Muslim festival
festivals.buys: new suits, pherans, abayas, dry fruits, bakery, henna, perfumes, footwear, gifts
festivals.impact_reason: Biggest valley shopping event; shoppers increasingly buy Eid dresses on Myntra/Amazon/Meesho; traders report online diverting sales

festivals.name: Eid al-Adha

festivals.buys: new clothes, spices, kitchen utensils, dry fruits, gifts
festivals.impact_reason: Second biggest valley shopping peak; clothes, kitchenware and dry fruits; animals bought offline

festivals.name: Ramadan

festivals.impact_reason: Month-long grocery and pre-Eid fashion demand; online Eid shopping rising

festivals.buys: black kurtas and abayas, langar/nazr groceries

states.culture: Buddhist Leh and Shia Muslim Kargil; small population, tourism-driven economy; buying is seasonal and stocks up before winter road closures.
states.ecommerce: Amazon delivers to Leh (its highest-elevation route since 2017) via local partners; deliveries can take 10-15 days and roads close ~4 months a year; no quick-commerce apps.
